What guests say about the staff

“I got dengue in Kandy and the staff at KA helped nurse me back to health with Ayurvedic medicines (on top of what the hospital was already giving me) They are the kindest people and they attract good vibes. I met some of the best people here :)”

Mia, USA, on Hostelworld, February 2026

“Family” is the word guests keep using. One of them caught dengue in Kandy and wrote that the staff helped nurse her back to health with Ayurvedic medicines, on top of what the hospital was already giving her.

On Booking.com the staff get 9.9 out of 10, the hostel's highest score there. Hostelworld guests give them the same 9.9, and only value for money and security do better, both at a full 10.

“Lovely location away from the main road. So close to the beach! The most amazing family who look after you like you're one of their own. Thank you KA!”

Clara, United Kingdom, on Booking.com

Dorms and private rooms

Mixed, female and male dormitories with bunk beds, plus double rooms and deluxe doubles. Every room has air conditioning and a fan, a private locker and a personal fridge. The bathrooms are modern, some of them open to the sky, and the showers are hot.

“It's a calm and quiet place, a wonderful staff, caring owners and clean. I had a really good time even i havnt spent much time there. beds are compfy and it has aircon and warm water.”

Wolfgang, Austria, on Booking.com

Breakfast changes every morning

Breakfast is included and it is Sri Lankan: rotis, hoppers, pancakes, eggs, a fruit platter, and a vegan option if you need one. It changes daily, which guests mention more often than anything else on the property.

“Great family owned hostel :-) they are really friendly and helpful! The breakfast always consists of a typical Sri Lankan dish (roti, hoppers,…) which changes every day and additionally a great fruit platter!! Dorms are big, bathrooms are nice with the whole outdoor thing :-)”

Elena, Germany, on Hostelworld, March 2026

What is here

A green garden and a chill zone. Free filtered water you can refill any time. Laundry. A minimarket on site. Scooter rental, with a surf rack if you ask. Luggage storage, lockers, and a 24-hour reception.

Pets are welcome on request at no charge. Children are not accommodated.

Kabalana: a sandy beach break that suits beginners and improvers, with The Rock reef alongside it when the swell is up.

“Owners very hospitable, breakfast in the morning was great, close to kabalana beach so great for surfing”

Getting here

Ahangama, a five-minute walk from Kabalana Beach. Koggala Airport is about 5 km away; Ahangama railway station is a little over 2 km. The property arranges a shuttle.
